newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunker prices firm again, except ARA.
newsitem.headline: European bunker prices firm again, except ARA.

text.p: European bunker prices firmed again on Friday, except in ARA where prices were steady, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at around $91/$92 fob as barges traded in the range $89/$90. The steadiness came after gains earlier this week.
Total ARA trading volume was low. Most estimates said there were under 10,000 tonnes of enquiries.
Hamburg rose with prompt local supply fairly tight.
Mediterranean prices mostly firmed by $1/$1.50 a tonne on fuel oil and $2/$3 on gas oil.
Trading was thin in most areas, particularly in Spain, where much of the country was on holiday.
